title: J002: Implement Docker E2E test with compose
summary: Docker E2E test infrastructure is correctly implemented. docker-compose.yml defines mock-api and plexd services on a shared bridge network with proper healthcheck, startup ordering, and configuration. test.sh orchestration script uses strict bash mode, trap-based cleanup, health polling, and assertion verification with clear diagnostic output on failure. Makefile target is self-contained and propagates exit codes. Documentation is thorough and accurate. All Go tests pass, go vet and golangci-lint are clean. Config field names in plexd-e2e.yaml match the Go struct lowercased conventions (baseurl, datadir, nodeid). The busybox-as-wget approach for distroless healthcheck is a well-known pattern.

tests_checklist.item: test.sh has trap-based cleanup on EXIT
test.sh prints container logs on failure
test.sh prints actual counter values on failure

code_quality_checklist.item: Follows existing Makefile target patterns (test, test-e2e, docker-build)
No hardcoded absolute paths in test.sh — uses SCRIPT_DIR
Config field names match Go struct conventions (no yaml tags → lowercased)
Documentation follows existing docs/reference/backend/ frontmatter pattern

security_checklist.item: No real secrets — e2e-test-token is a test fixture
No sensitive data exposed in logs

architecture_checklist.item: mock-api healthcheck on /v1/ping with distroless-compatible wget
plexd depends_on mock-api with condition: service_healthy
tmpfs mount at /var/lib/plexd for writable data directory
Port 18080 mapped to host for test script assertion polling

dry_yagni_checklist.item: Minimal config file with only required fields

fail_fast_checklist.item: test.sh exits on mock-api health timeout with logs
test.sh exits on assertion timeout with counter values and logs

defensive_checklist.item: Cleanup trap runs on EXIT regardless of outcome
curl failures handled gracefully in polling loop
jq fallback defaults for missing JSON fields (// 0, // empty)
docker compose down -v with 2>/dev/null || true in cleanup

suggested_improvements: Minor: test.sh could explicitly print which assertion(s) failed (e.g. 'FAIL: heartbeat_count=0 < 1') rather than only printing raw values — but current output is adequate for debugging
Minor: docker compose ps --format json output format varies between compose v2 versions; the dual jq path (.[0].Health // .Health) handles known variants well
next_steps: Run make test-e2e-docker in a Docker-capable environment to validate the full E2E flow (cannot be verified in this review environment without Docker)
